ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent using regional transit data and USDC micro-payments to coordinate carpools and shared rides for students navigating Waterloo during cold winter months.
ideas.title: Waterloo Transit Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a local pain felt directly by students in Waterloo during Hack the North, mirroring the winning pattern of solving local logistics and autonomous agent marketplaces.

ideas.pitch: A machine learning platform that forecasts Waterloo co-op interview probabilities and skill match rates using historical job board data and calibrated prediction intervals.
ideas.title: Co-op Interview Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an intense, highly relatable problem for every single university student participating in the Hack the North event regarding the continuous co-op application cycle.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered wellness assistant tailored for hackathons that tracks macro-nutrients and hydration from quick cafeteria photos to keep builders energized throughout the 49-hour sprint.
ideas.title: Hackathon Health & Nutrition Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses immediate physical burnout and health tracking during an intense multi-day hackathon sprint, following the successful pattern of targeted utility apps.

ideas.pitch: An AWS-powered financial compliance and anti-money laundering risk detection dashboard utilizing graph intelligence and explainable machine learning models for fintech APIs.
ideas.title: Quantum Risk AML Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases complex enterprise-grade data structures and graph intelligence that technical judges look for in rigorous developer challenges.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring tool to track campus infrastructure changes, construction progress, and environmental land compliance around the university grounds.
ideas.title: Campus Satellite CompliCheck
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines geospatial data analysis with automated computer vision reporting, standing out through difficult technical execution similar to top-performing monitoring hacks.
